inputs.name: Installed NOR FIT
inputs.revision: Mosaico boot-display FIT used in the R3 root trial

scenario: One ordinary POWER-on boot of an installed V1.2 system; serial output was observed separately from the display.
expected: Normal POWER startup shows the boot indicator, mounts the installed NOR LittleFS root, and reaches the end of startup.
observed: UART recorded POWERON SPI, SPL, OpenSBI, U-Boot 2026.10, FIT handoff, the NetBSD 11.1 ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS_NOR #6 banner, and LittleFS mounted from flash1. The operator separately reported seeing LOGIN, then sshd, then the final Startup complete message. The /var/run/rc.log timestamps spanned 12:00:09 to 12:04:52, and rc exited with status 0. A subsequent SSH session using the pinned host key succeeded and remained connected for 52 seconds. WPA status was COMPLETED with key_mgmt SAE, and IPv4 was present during that session. Post-write esptool hash verification passed for the FIT and R3 LittleFS image; their SHA-256 values are recorded in inputs.

measurements.name: rc-log-interval
measurements.unit: seconds between /var/run/rc.log timestamps; rc exit status 0

limits: One reported V1.2 unit and one ordinary POWER boot are covered.
The report does not identify the boot indicator text or establish that every startup line appeared.
The device clock reported a date in 2010; the rc duration is the timestamp delta within the same log, not an absolute wall-clock measurement.
The bounded 52-second SSH session does not establish longer-term stability or repeated-boot reliability.
The source-level explanation for the previous root reset is separate from this physical boot observation.
